votes.sql:
SELECT 
    s.School,
    AVG(f.`Enrollment (K-12)`) AS average_students
FROM frpm f
INNER JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE f.`Enrollment (K-12)` IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY s.CDSCode, s.School

votes.sql:
WITH frpm_2013_14 AS (
    SELECT 
        CDSCode,
        `District Name`,
        `School Name`,
        `Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)` AS frpm_2013_14
    FROM frpm
    WHERE `Academic Year` = '2013-14'
),
frpm_2018_19 AS (
    SELECT 
        CDSCode,
        `District Name`,
        `School Name`,
        `Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)` AS frpm_2018_19
    FROM frpm
    WHERE `Academic Year` = '2018-19'
),
calculate_changes AS (
    SELECT 
        c1.CDSCode,
        c1.`District Name`,
        c1.`School Name`,
        COALESCE(c2.frpm_2018_19, 0) - COALESCE(c1.frpm_2013_14, 0) AS frpm_change_pct
    FROM frpm_2013_14 c1
    LEFT JOIN frpm_2018_19 c2 ON c1.CDSCode = c2.CDSCode
),
district_aggregate AS (
    SELECT 
        `District Name`,
        AVG(frpm_change_pct) AS district_avg_frpm_change
    FROM calculate_changes
    GROUP BY `District Name`
),
school_report AS (
    SELECT 
        cc.CDSCode,
        cc.`District Name`,
        cc.`School Name`,
        cc.frpm_change_pct,
        ss.`AvgScrMath` AS avg_sat_math_score
    FROM calculate_changes cc
    LEFT JOIN satscores ss ON cc.CDSCode = ss.cds
)
SELECT 
    sr.`School Name`,
    sr.district_avg_frpm_change,
    sr.frpm_change_pct,
    sr.avg_sat_math_score
FROM school_report sr
JOIN district_aggregate da ON sr.`District Name` = da.`District Name`
ORDER BY da.district_avg_frpm_change DESC;
}

WITH frpm13 AS (
  SELECT
    "CDSCode",
    "Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)" AS pct_frpm_13,
    "FRPM Count (K-12)" AS frpm_cnt_13,
    "Enrollment (K-12)" AS enroll_13
  FROM frpm
  WHERE "Academic Year" = '2013-14'
),
frpm19 AS (
  SELECT
    "CDSCode",
    "Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)" AS pct_frpm_19,
    "FRPM Count (K-12)" AS frpm_cnt_19,
    "Enrollment (K-12)" AS enroll_19
  FROM frpm
  WHERE "Academic Year" = '2018-19'
),
school_frpm AS (
  SELECT
    f13."CDSCode" AS cds,
    f13.pct_frpm_13,
    f19.pct_frpm_19,
    (f19.pct_frpm_19 - f13.pct_frpm_13) AS frpm_change,
    f13.frpm_cnt_13,
    f19.frpm_cnt_19,
    f13.enroll_13,
    f19.enroll_19
  FROM frpm13 f13
  LEFT JOIN frpm19 f19 ON f13."CDSCode" = f19."CDSCode"
),
sat AS (
  SELECT
    cds,
    "AvgScrMath" AS avg_sat_math
  FROM satscores
),
school_info AS (
  SELECT
    s."District Name" AS district_name,
    s."School Name" AS school_name,
    s."District Code" AS district_code,
    sf.frpm_change,
    sat.avg_sat_math,
    NULL AS teacher_count,
    NULL AS avg_years_experience
  FROM schools s
  JOIN school_frpm sf ON s."CDSCode" = sf.cds
  LEFT JOIN sat ON s."CDSCode" = sat.cds
),
district_agg13 AS (
  SELECT
    f."District Code" AS district_code,
    SUM(f."FRPM Count (K-12)") AS total_frpm_13,
    SUM(f."Enrollment (K-12)") AS total_enroll_13
  FROM frpm f
  WHERE f."Academic Year" = '2013-14'
  GROUP BY f."District Code"
),
district_agg19 AS (
  SELECT
    f."District Code" AS district_code,
    SUM(f."FRPM Count (K-12)") AS total_frpm_19,
    SUM(f."Enrollment (K-12)") AS total_enroll_19
  FROM frpm f
  WHERE f."Academic Year" = '2018-19'
  GROUP BY f."District Code"
),
district_change AS (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(d13.district_code, d19.district_code) AS district_code,
    CASE WHEN d13.total_enroll_13 = 0 THEN NULL ELSE d13.total_frpm_13 * 1.0 / d13.total_enroll_13 END AS pct_13,
    CASE WHEN d19.total_enroll_19 = 0 THEN NULL ELSE d19.total_frpm_19 * 1.0 / d19.total_enroll_19 END AS pct_19,
    (CASE WHEN d19.total_enroll_19 = 0 THEN NULL ELSE d19.total_frpm_19 * 1.0 / d19.total_enroll_19 END -
     CASE WHEN d13.total_enroll_13 = 0 THEN NULL ELSE d13.total_frpm_13 * 1.0 / d13.total_enroll_13 END) AS district_frpm_change
  FROM district_agg13 d13
  LEFT JOIN district_agg19 d19 ON d13.district_code = d19.district_code
)
SELECT
  si.district_name,
  si.school_name,
  si.teacher_count,
  si.avg_years_experience,
  si.avg_sat_math,
  si.frpm_change
FROM school_info si
JOIN district_change dc ON si.district_code = dc.district_code
ORDER BY dc.district_frpm_change DESC;

votes.sql:
SELECT s."School" AS school_name,
       ss."AvgScrMath" AS avg_math_score,
       f."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)" AS enrollment_8th_grade
FROM schools s
JOIN satscores ss ON s."CDSCode" = ss."cds"
JOIN frpm f ON s."CDSCode" = f."CDSCode"
WHERE s."County" = 'Alameda'
  AND s."EILCode" = 'INTMIDJR'
ORDER BY ss."AvgScrMath" DESC;

SELECT 
    sch."School" AS school_name,
    AVG(s.AvgScrMath) AS avg_math_score,
    SUM(s.NumTstTakr) AS num_students
FROM schools sch
JOIN satscores s ON sch.CDSCode = s.cds
WHERE sch.County = 'Alameda'
    AND sch.SOCType LIKE '%Middle%'
GROUP BY sch.CDSCode, sch."School"
HAVING s.AvgScrMath IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY avg_math_score DESC;

WITH filtered AS (
    SELECT
        s."CDSCode",
        f."School Type",
        f."Enrollment (K-12)",
        sat."AvgScrMath"
    FROM "schools" s
    JOIN "frpm" f ON s."CDSCode" = f."CDSCode"
    JOIN "satscores" sat ON s."CDSCode" = sat."cds"
    WHERE s."County" = 'Alameda'
      AND f."School Type" = 'Intermediate/Middle Schools (Public)'
      AND sat."AvgScrMath" IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
    "AvgScrMath" AS average_math_score,
    "Enrollment (K-12)" AS student_count
FROM filtered
WHERE "AvgScrMath" = (SELECT MAX("AvgScrMath") FROM filtered);

votes.sql:
-- NOTE: This database schema does not contain individual student records, grade-specific test scores, or parent contact information. 
-- Only school-level aggregated data is available. Returning available school-level SAT Math scores with school contact info.
SELECT 
    ROUND(sat.AvgScrMath, 2) AS avg_math_score,
    sch.School AS school_name,
    sch.Phone AS school_phone,
    sch.AdmEmail1 AS administrator_email
FROM satscores sat
JOIN schools sch ON sat.cds = sch.CDSCode
WHERE sat.AvgScrMath IS NOT NULL 
  AND sat.NumTstTakr > 0
ORDER BY sat.AvgScrMath DESC

### Step 1: Understand the Question

- **satscores**: Contains SAT scores, test takers, enrollments - NO teacher data  
- **schools**: Contains school addresses, contact info, status, codes - NO teacher data

SELECT s."School" AS school, NULL AS teacher_count
FROM schools s

votes.sql:
WITH charter AS (
    SELECT f.CDSCode
    FROM frpm f
    WHERE f."Charter School (Y/N)" = 1
),
data AS (
    SELECT
        f.CDSCode,
        f."Academic Year" AS AcademicYear,
        f."Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)" AS free_pct,
        s.AvgScrMath AS math_score
    FROM frpm f
    JOIN satscores s ON f.CDSCode = s.cds
    JOIN charter c ON f.CDSCode = c.CDSCode
),
ordered AS (
    SELECT
        d.*, 
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY d.CDSCode ORDER BY d.AcademicYear DESC) AS rn,
        LAG(d.free_pct) OVER (PARTITION BY d.CDSCode ORDER BY d.AcademicYear) AS prev_free,
        LAG(d.math_score) OVER (PARTITION BY d.CDSCode ORDER BY d.AcademicYear) AS prev_math
    FROM data d
),
changes AS (
    SELECT
        o.CDSCode,
        o.AcademicYear,
        (o.free_pct - o.prev_free) AS change_free,
        (o.math_score - o.prev_math) AS change_math
    FROM ordered o
    WHERE o.rn <= 5
      AND o.prev_free IS NOT NULL
      AND o.prev_math IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
    sch.School AS school_name,
    ch.AcademicYear
FROM changes ch
JOIN schools sch ON ch.CDSCode = sch.CDSCode
WHERE ch.change_free > 0
  AND ch.change_math < 0
ORDER BY sch.School, ch.AcademicYear;

WITH charter_data AS (
    SELECT 
        f.CDSCode,
        f.`School Name`,
        f.`Academic Year`,
        f.`Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)`,
        s.`AvgScrMath`
    FROM frpm f
    JOIN satscores s ON f.CDSCode = s.cds
    WHERE f.`Charter School (Y/N)` = 1
),
year_changes AS (
    SELECT 
        CDSCODE,
        `School Name`,
        `Academic Year`,
        `Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)`,
        `AvgScrMath`,
        `Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)` - LAG(`Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)`) OVER (PARTITION BY CDSCODE ORDER BY `Academic Year`) AS free_meal_change,
        `AvgScrMath` - LAG(`AvgScrMath`) OVER (PARTITION BY CDSCODE ORDER BY `Academic Year`) AS math_score_change
    FROM charter_data
)
SELECT `Academic Year` FROM year_changes
WHERE free_meal_change > 0 AND math_score_change < 0;

WITH charter_data AS (
    SELECT
        f."CDSCode",
        f."School Name" AS school_name,
        f."Academic Year",
        CAST(SUBSTR(f."Academic Year", 1, 4) AS INTEGER) AS start_year,
        f."Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)" AS free_pct,
        s.AvgScrMath AS sat_math
    FROM frpm f
    JOIN satscores s ON f."CDSCode" = s.cds
    WHERE f."Charter School (Y/N)" = 1
      AND f."Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)" IS NOT NULL
      AND s.AvgScrMath IS NOT NULL
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        LAG(free_pct) OVER (PARTITION BY "CDSCode" ORDER BY start_year) AS prev_free_pct,
        LAG(sat_math) OVER (PARTITION BY "CDSCode" ORDER BY start_year) AS prev_sat_math
    FROM charter_data
    WHERE start_year >= (
        SELECT CAST(SUBSTR(MAX("Academic Year"), 1, 4) AS INTEGER) - 4
        FROM frpm
    )
),
changes AS (
    SELECT
        school_name,
        "Academic Year" AS academic_year,
        (free_pct - prev_free_pct) AS free_meal_change,
        (sat_math - prev_sat_math) AS sat_math_change
    FROM ranked
    WHERE prev_free_pct IS NOT NULL AND prev_sat_math IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
    school_name,
    academic_year
FROM changes
WHERE free_meal_change > 0 AND sat_math_change < 0
ORDER BY school_name, academic_year;
